description: Minimal versioned hand-off from NB01 to NB02. GITV01008430.1 is the OPERATIONAL reference because it reproduces the published CDS and protein exactly; this is not a claim of unique biological identity (accession, CDS and protein remain AMBIGUOUS in NB01). Everything below is re-derived from the hash-validated TSA by zeaguard.nb02_reference.verify_reference.

coordinates.cds_to_stored_strand: cds_tx_end - cds_pos + 1 for records on the '-' strand
coordinates.note: cds_tx_start/cds_tx_end are 1-based inclusive on the stored strand of the TSA record

source.citation: Dalaison-Fuentes et al. 2023, Pestic. Biochem. Physiol. 196:105618, DOI 10.1016/j.pestbp.2023.105618
source.supplement_locator: Table S1 (primer sequences and amplicon lengths)

main_text_locators.methods_2_4: dsRNase-2 fragment of 330 bp; PCR; second PCR adding T7 promoters; dsRNA synthesis

benchmark.evidence_scope: The experimental-function claim rests on the protocol statements below; their provenance is experimental_protocol_verification, which is separate from the sequence verification.

benchmark_sequence_verification_detail.supplement: Table S1 primers and amplicon lengths read from the local S1 PDF text layer (sha256 above)
benchmark_sequence_verification_detail.reference: published dsRNase-2 cDNA TRINITY_DN22752_c0_g2_i1 (data/reference/target_anchor_sequences.fasta) and the operational CDS of the hash-validated TSA
recomputed_by_verify_reference: forward and reverse primer sites exact and unique in the operational CDS
span CDS 814-1143 = 330 nt and its sha256
amplicon lengths 330 and 360 (two 15 nt T7 tails) consistent with the mapped span
known variant inside the span: CDS 816 only (defined, synonymous)
benchmark body identical in the published cDNA and in the operational CDS

verification.experimental_protocol_verification_detai: Protocols INJECTION_PRECONDITIONING and ORAL_COFEEDING and the Results 3.4 endpoints were supplied by the project with the section locators; the agent could not read the main text (ScienceDirect captcha not bypassed; CONICET repository handle 11336/221063 unreachable). They are stored unchanged.
verification.experimental_protocol_promotion_conditio: Promote to VERIFIED_AGAINST_PRIMARY_TEXT only after the agent reads the main text, confirms each statement, and the change is committed explicitly.

protocols.name: INJECTION_PRECONDITIONING
protocols.endpoints_note: not supplied with the locators; to be read from the article (Results) before any use

protocols.name: ORAL_COFEEDING
endpoints_reported: embryo viability: lower proportion of viable eggs
Dmai-dsRNase-2 transcript in midgut at day 7: reduced
protocols.authors_conclusion: dsRNase-2 in the diet improves the response to the dsRNA against BicC

benchmark.claims_policy: The two protocols are never merged. No efficacy score is derived for the fragment: the co-feeding design also delivers BicC dsRNA, so its endpoints are descriptive and not attributable to the dsRNase-2 fragment alone.
